Now I'm cataloging the LNG plants still in development stages across Vietnam—Quang Ninh, Thai Binh, and several projects in the south like Hai Lang with its massive 4,500 MW capacity tied to the Blue Whale gas field, plus the Son My and Bac Lieu facilities that are part of the longer-term pipeline. Continuing through the domestic gas projects, with Cong Thanh totaling 4,500 MW across its phases, then moving into the Dung Quat facilities and the O Mon complex in Can Tho which has multiple planned units alongside its existing operating plant. I'm working through the smaller and older coal plants now—places like Uong Bi, An Khanh, Cao Ngan, Son Dong, and others scattered across Thai Nguyen and Quang Ninh—but I need to verify their exact capacities and commissioning dates.
